headline: GIC Re appoints two bank EDs as non-exec directors
summary: General Insurance Corporation of India appointed S K Majumdar and Pramod Kumar Dwibedi as Non-Executive Directors. Both are Executive Directors at Canara Bank and Bank of India respectively.

headline: Dilip Buildcon wins ₹419.47 crore Gurgaon metro order
summary: Dilip Buildcon received a ₹419.47 crore Letter of Acceptance from Gurugram Metro Rail Limited for a depot-cum-workshop project with a 21-month completion period.

headline: Stocks to Watch: Oriana Power, Ashoka Buildcon, Coal India in focus
summary: Oriana Power rallies on Gobardhan approvals while Ashoka Buildcon faces Saudi project cancellation. Coal India files RHP for Mahanadi IPO as Dilip Buildcon secures metro orders.

headline: Prestige Estates launches ₹5,500 mn North Bengaluru project
summary: Prestige Estates Projects Limited launched Prestige Avon in North Bengaluru with a GDV of ₹5,500 million. The 3-acre residential project comprises 260 apartments.

headline: Jupiter Wagons wins order worth over ₹128 crore
summary: Jupiter Wagons has secured another order exceeding ₹128 crore from JSW (South) Rail Logistics, adding to its order book in the rail freight segment.

headline: Natco Pharma gets USFDA EIR with VAI status for Vizag plant
summary: Natco Pharma received a USFDA Establishment Inspection Report with Voluntary Action Indicated status for its Vizag facility following an inspection held August 17-21, 2026, which had yielded four Form 483 observations.

headline: Highway Infrastructure wins ₹198.31 crore CISF project
summary: Highway Infrastructure has received an approval letter for a ₹198.31 crore CISF Battalion Infrastructure Project, marking a significant order win for the company.

headline: Skipper targets ₹7,500 crore order inflows in FY27
summary: Skipper aims for 35% growth in FY27 order inflows to ₹7,500 crore, backed by a record order book of ₹10,066 crore and strong export expansion plans.

headline: Diamond Power secures ₹708 crore HVDC contract
summary: Diamond Power Infrastructure secured a ₹708 crore contract from Adani Energy for a 6,000 MW HVDC green energy project, marking a significant order win.

headline: Rising LNG prices squeeze city gas distributors' margins
summary: Rising LNG prices and supply issues have weighed on city gas distributors' profitability, with Indraprastha Gas reporting an EBITDA loss amid the pressure.

headline: Juniper Green Energy starts 94.77 MWh BESS
summary: Juniper Green Energy has commissioned a 94.77 MWh Battery Energy Storage System, taking its total operational capacity to 698 MWh.

headline: Wanbury's Tanuku API facility clears South Korea MFDS CGMP inspection
summary: Wanbury's Tanuku API facility has successfully passed the South Korea MFDS CGMP inspection without any observations, marking a key regulatory milestone.

headline: Schneider Electric Infra appoints Deepika Srivastava as CS
summary: Schneider Electric Infrastructure Ltd appoints Deepika Srivastava as Company Secretary effective Jan 1, 2027. She succeeds Sumit Goel who resigned to pursue a career outside the group.
